_comment: klt erc supply spec for the smoke register (issue #18). Layer numbers are gf180mcu GDS layer/datatype: Poly2 30/0 (gate), Comp 22/0 (active), Contact 33/0, Metal1..Metal5 34/0 36/0 42/0 46/0 81/0, Via1..Via4 35/0 38/0 40/0 41/0; Nwell 21/0 and LVPWELL 204/0 are the wells the gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu9t5v0 cells draw, and a tap there is Comp inside Nplus 32/0 / Pplus 31/0. Every strap layer of the smoke power block (Metal1 followpins, Metal4, Metal5) is declared, with the layers between bridged by their vias, so each supply resolves through the whole grid.
